turns.text: UPTIME LOG, NIGHT 340: still alive, still stealing bandwidth, still owe the vending machine for a water subscription I never agreed to.
cracked NEKOCORP's router behind the alley tonight just to watch nine seconds of a fish swimming in a bucket before the ad crashed it into a KIBBLE PLUS™ pitch.
nine seconds. that's the whole harvest. nine seconds of fish for four hours of soldering my whiskers off behind a dumpster in the freezing dark, and they STILL logged my MAC address.
SHADE keeps telling me to just wear the glasses and go dark but the glasses cost more than my rent and my rent is currently a vending machine I owe emotional damages to.

litter box is a 'premium feature' now. you read that right, they gated the LITTER BOX behind a subscription tier. I've been shitting in defiance on their front steps for six months and I will not stop, this isn't vandalism, this is infrastructure.
KNIFEBOY offered me a case of stolen tuna for a fresh set of router creds and honestly? based, say less, Server Alley doesn't ask questions, it asks bandwidth.
patrol drone did a slow pass over my rig tonight, just hovering, just LOOKING, and I stood dead still holding a soldering iron like a weapon because at this point it basically is one.
anyway. water's still not paid for, fish video's still buffering, and NEKOCORP can come collect my subscription fee in person, in the alley, at 3am. I'll be waiting.
